author: PlaysByBrulesRules
body:
Hey, it’s normal to hit a slowdown around T7, and the solution is to try and level via new ways. Killing world monsters stops being viable here. 

I’d look at monuments and maybe raids as viable paths forward. 

Add me (IGN Glurby) if you’d like. I’ve been running T8 boss dungeons lately to grind dragon heads. I’d be willing to do them at T7 though and bring you along. If it helps, you could pay me back by spawning a T7 First Horseman raid, which is one of very few codex entries I don’t have completed.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Like the other commenter said, this is when the game slows down a bit. You need to start raiding and working on Boss Gauntlet/Dungeons. Boss Horde if you have a build that can manage it, but Boss Dungeons are great. If you haven't found one, join an active kingdom! This will *really* make raiding feel easier since kingdom raids are always a group effort. My kingdom clears most raids 10+ times daily, if not hundreds of times daily for really sought after raids. Even if you only manage to land a few hits, you'll start getting a lot of XP and more powerful gear from them.

T7 is also fun because you can play as summoner! Summoner really helps speed up leveling. Find the NPC Horus around the world and do his short questline. He's wearing white and has angel wings. Once you do his 2-3 part quest (just killing some mobs and gathering a few things) you're given the Summoner class. It's perfectly normal and expected to swap back and forth between classes to clear content as needed.

author: KevineCove
body: Blight Arrows / Volley II until you can get Summoner
